approach.summary: Forward raw webhook values once through an injected Transformer with ordered observer notifications
rules: Delegate raw input exactly once without trimming, uppercasing, coercion, retries, panic recovery, or value replacement
Return the original service result and error unchanged, including results returned with errors
For a non-nil observer call Started before Transform and Finished only when Transform returns no error

title: Event forwarding adapters
goal: Deliver raw events through injected services with observer ordering
constraints: Delegate raw values exactly once; do not normalize or coerce
Observer started before service; finished only on success
required_verification: Service substitution, error identity, and observer ordering tests
